title: BPW-2026-0597
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0597
AFE – COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES
Bureau of Sanitation and Office of Accounting are requesting Board approval and execution of an Authority for Expenditure in the amount of $454,500 for encumbrance of funds to pay for the Solid Waste Management Fee of $1.50 per ton for the tonnage diverted to Waste Management - El Sobrante Landfill for Fiscal Year 26-27 for the term July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027.
(AE27508534M, Fund 508 - Solid Waste Resources Revenue Fund, Dept. 50, Appropriation Unit 50EX82)
